svg.title: Account-linking decision flows
svg.desc: Two flows after an OAuth callback that was authorized and carries a valid state. Ordinary OAuth sign-in: an already linked (provider_id, account_id) signs in as its user; an unlinked identity whose email belongs to an existing Sisukas user is not merged; a verified, eligible new identity creates a new user; registration of other identities is not established by the #215 tests. Explicit OAuth linking requires a valid session, a verified provider email, an email equal to the user's, and a provider identity not assigned to another user; only then is an account row added for the existing user.id. Rejected linking creates or reassigns no provider-account association.
svg.text: sign in with existing method, then link
Rejected linking must not create or reassign a provider-account association. Temporary OAuth verification state and existing
session handling are separate concerns. A matching email is required for explicit linking but never merges accounts on its own
(disableImplicitLinking: true). Gates are drawn as logical conditions; Better Auth's internal evaluation order may differ.
